C1410.title: South Korea Makes First Arrest Tied to Memecoin Rug Pull
C1410.summary: South Korean prosecutors arrested a suspect linked to a memecoin rug pull on the Pump.fun platform, a scam that caused investors to lose approximately $599,000. This marks the first arrest in South Korea over a memecoin rug pull.
